evals.name: oas32-stage0-plan
evals.prompt: I want to add OpenAPI 3.2.0 support to ApiDOM (parent version 3.1). Do only the research and planning step (before phase 1): produce the tracking document with the field map (new vs inherited fields per object), the external URLs we'll need, and every integration point across packages. Don't write code yet.
evals.expected_output: Tracking doc with accurate field map, verified URLs and complete cross-package integration list.
assertions: Field map names at least 15 of the 18 distinctive OAS 3.2 new fields
Components.pathItems, License.identifier and Info.summary are treated as inherited, not new
Does not list a webhooks field on Components
Dialect URL is https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.2/dialect/2025-09-17 (not /dialect/base)
Assigns apidom-reference parsers, resolve/dereference/bundle strategies and saturated.ts to phase 3
Lists apidom-ls parser-factory.ts and content detection in utils
Lists apidom-playground wiring
Lists the root package.json unlink script
Mentions propagating new fields to the replace-empty-element refractor plugin
Addresses detection exclusivity between the 3.1 and 3.2 adapters
Plans four phases (namespace, parser adapters, apidom-reference, apidom-ls), each ending in its own PR, stacked in that order
